results.title: Tension mounts at AMU as students block all entry gates; proctor says 'outsider' detained from hostel
results.description: The situation had turned tense on Saturday evening after protesters allegedly tried to enter the proctor's office following reports that police had detained four students from a hostel in MM Hall.
